scripts.deploy:selfhost: wrangler d1 migrations apply D1 --remote --env selfhost && wrangler deploy --env selfhost

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Session signing secret. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32` (≥32 chars).

TOKEN_HASH_SECRET.description: API token hashing secret. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

INTERNAL_API_KEY.description: Shared key for Worker-to-Worker `/internal` calls. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

MCP_SIGNING_KEY.description: Optional. Only needed if you deploy the MCP worker.

D1.description: Primary Seal database (auto-provisioned on first selfhost deploy).

DOCUMENTS_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for PDFs and signed artifacts (auto-provisioned).
